title: Behind-wall dirt runoff stripe
change: Add one short vertical dirt-runoff stripe to an occluded wall-back panel.
implementation_notes: Use a sparse opacity mask with a soft termination; keep width narrow and avoid repeating bands.
capture_safe_reason: The weathering remains behind the wall and is too small to influence the frozen harbor silhouette or water contrast.
acceptance_test: Only the intended occluded inspection angle reveals the runoff stripe; Harbor remains usable at 11/11 capture positions.

title: Behind-wall layered dirt patch
change: Add a single small layered rust-and-dirt patch behind the wall using existing imported texture channels.
implementation_notes: Keep the patch compact, desaturated, and fully occluded until x>=bx+3; use roughness variation as the primary signal.
capture_safe_reason: The asset is a tiny behind-wall material accent, so it cannot stack into a hero foreground change or disturb the 11/11 freeze.
acceptance_test: The patch reads as layered weathering only in the intended behind-wall position and all frozen cameras remain usable.

title: Fuselage inspection hatch rim
change: Add one shallow offset inspection-hatch rim with a deliberately interrupted lower edge on the fuselage.
implementation_notes: Use a small rectangular rim at x>=bx+3 with two missing corner segments; keep the base panel bright enough for unlit HF separation.
capture_safe_reason: A single small panel accent adds silhouette-adjacent structure without introducing dark PBR coverage.
acceptance_test: Verify hatch rim reads as a distinct local feature in YakBeauty while Prop remains usable and bright.

title: Cowling louver break pair
change: Add two short offset louver strips on the cowling with unequal spacing and a visible center gap.
implementation_notes: Keep each louver narrow and shallow at x>=bx+3; use bright-to-mid unlit contrast and no black cavity material.
capture_safe_reason: The proposal adds localized panel rhythm without expanding any dark region in the nose.
acceptance_test: Check two readable louver clusters in YakBeauty and no uniqueness or black collapse in PropNose.

title: Ricochet spark streak
change: Add one short directional ricochet streak leaving each metallic impact point.
implementation_notes: Orient the streak along the impact normal, use a 0.06 second lifetime, and clamp length to a few pixels in the final capture.
capture_safe_reason: A single tiny additive streak improves impact readability without affecting broad regions of either camera.
acceptance_test: The streak is visible only at impact locations and does not become a continuous line or screen-space artifact.

title: Water splash crown tips
change: Add five tiny additive crown tips at the outer edge of a water splash impact.
implementation_notes: Use a low-opacity pale foam tint, 0.14 second lifetime, and keep all tips inside the existing splash footprint.
capture_safe_reason: Only small additive tips are introduced, with no change to ocean materials or large silhouette coverage.
acceptance_test: Splash edges become legible at capture resolution while horizon and water values remain stable.

title: Corrugated facade rib cadence
change: Add three bright corrugated vertical ribs to one apartment or industrial facade section.
implementation_notes: Use sparse, light-gray ribs with alternating roughness; keep the section behind wall at x>=bx+3 and avoid full-facade repetition.
capture_safe_reason: Localized behind-wall geometry adds bright vertical structure without introducing a dark sole FOV material.
acceptance_test: Capture City and check that ribs read as three separate facade edges without clipping, aliasing, or uniqueness collapse.
